'''Desic Malboan''', was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served in the [[Thaereian system]], an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] from the [[Thaereian system]], during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], while on duty aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Thaere Runner]]'' on customs duty in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], Malboan attached a [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacon]] to a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] that the [[Thaereian]]s had stopped for inspection.

==Biography==
Desic Malboan was a [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Scoundrel/Legends|scoundrel]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|soldier]] in the [[Thaereian military]],<ref name="OB" /> an [[Army/Legends|armed force]] from the [[Thaereian system]],<ref name="OT">{{Wizards|url=rpga/livingforce/article.asp?x=lf/swlf20011004b_thaere&c=swlfc|text=Over Thaere}}</ref> during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Malboan was a member of the military's [[Thaereian Intelligence]] information-gathering branch and he held the rank of [[Corporal/Legends|corporal]].<ref name="OB" /> Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="date">The ''[[Living Force Campaign Guide]]'' states that the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign is set one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]], an event that is dated to [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] by ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. As the Living Force adventure ''[[Below the Belt: Philology|Philology]]'' [[Cularin's disappearance|moved]] the campaign forward ten years to the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']] is therefore dated to circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].</ref> he was assigned to serve aboard the [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Thaere Runner]]'' on customs duty in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]],<ref name="OB" /> a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that the [[Thaereian]] military had been [[Thaereian Navy charter|chartered]] by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] to defend.<ref name="OT" /> Malboan had orders to secretly attach [[Homing beacon/Legends|tracking beacons]] to all [[Starship/Legends|starships]] that the customs [[Corvette/Legends|corvette]] inspected, so that the Thaereians could track the vessels' movements.<ref name="OB" />

{{RPG|[[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']]}}
While Malboan was on duty, a starship bound for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Druckenwell/Legends|Druckenwell]] was boarded by the ''Thaere Runner'' near to a [[Cularin comet cloud|comet cloud]] on the edge of the [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] system. As the vessel's [[Heroes of Cularin|crew]] were questioned by the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] Thaereian [[Officer/Legends|officer]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Toric Bisilt]], Malboan and two other soldiers were ordered by Bisilt to search the suspect ship for contraband. Amid the inspection, Malboan fitted a tracking beacon in a hidden spot near to the vessel's [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]]&mdash;a device that facilitated travel through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]]&mdash;where the tracker was concealed from [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] scans and visual inspection. The Thaereians then released the ship and allowed it to proceed to Druckenwell.<ref name="OB" />
{{Endgame}}

==Talents and abilities==
Malboan was multi-[[Language/Legends|lingual]]; he could read and [[Writing/Legends|write]] [[Galactic Basic Standard|Basic]] and [[Sullustese/Legends|Sullustan]] and could also speak the languages [[Bothese|Bothan]] and [[Rodese/Legends|Rodian]].<ref name="OB" />

==Equipment==
While inspecting the starship boarded by the ''Thaere Runner'' near to the Cularin system [[Comet/Legends|comet]] [[cloud]], Malboan wore a [[Breath mask/Legends|breath mask]], [[Blast vest/Legends|blast vest]] and [[Blast helmet/Legends|blast helmet]]. He was also armed with a [[Blaster carbine/Legends|blaster carbine]].<ref name="OB" />

==Behind the scenes==
Desic Malboan appeared within [[Star Wars Legends|''Star Wars'' Legends]] continuity in [[Looking In: Outward Bound|''Outward Bound'']], a [[2002]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] adventure by [[Morrie Mullins]] and [[Lee Pickler]] that formed part of the [[Looking In trilogy|''Looking In'' trilogy]] of [[RPGA]]'s [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In the adventure, the players roleplay as the crew of the starship encountered by the ''Thaere Runner'' on the edge of the Cularin comet cloud. It is possible for the players' vessel to be boarded by the ''Thaere Runner'', in which case Malboan attempts to attach a tracking beacon to the their ship. It is alternately possible for the players to engage in combat with Malboan and the other Thaereians when the crew of the ''Thaere Runner'' attempt to board the players' vessel. It is also possible for the player characters to destroy the ''Thaere Runner'', in which case Malboan and the rest of the corvette's crew are [[Death/Legends|killed]].<ref name="OB" />
